mapper.insert: insert into item(cover_images, name, price, introduction, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{item.coverImages}, #{item.name}, #{item.price}, #{item.introduction}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDeleted})
mapper.update: update item set cover_images = #{item.coverImages}, name=#{item.name}, price=#{item.price}, introduction=#{item.introduction}, update_time=#{item.updateTime} where id = #{item.id}
